scripts.cap:sync: npm run build && npx cap sync android
scripts.cap:run: npm run cap:sync && npx cap run android
scripts.cap:apk: npm run cap:sync && cd android && JAVA_HOME="${JAVA_HOME:-$(/usr/libexec/java_home -v 21 2>/dev/null || echo /usr/local/opt/openjdk@21/libexec/openjdk.jdk/Contents/Home)}" bash gradlew assembleDebug
scripts.cap:release: npm run cap:sync && cd android && JAVA_HOME="${JAVA_HOME:-$(/usr/libexec/java_home -v 21 2>/dev/null || echo /usr/local/opt/openjdk@21/libexec/openjdk.jdk/Contents/Home)}" bash gradlew bundleRelease assembleRelease
